A Roman silver 'ToT' finger ring dating from 100 - 300 AD. It is a complete silver finger ring of Henig Type VIII. The bezel is circular, slightly raised from the hoop and is inscribed with the serrifed letters 'ToT'. The shoulders are triangular in plan with serrated edges and are decorated with a 'V' shaped incised groove. The hoop is thick and rectangular in cross-section. The letters 'ToT'…
